text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen up~
I came up with a new recipe to make a brand-new chanko nabe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The star ingredient of the whole dish
is nowhere to be found,
no matter where I look!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, what a bummer~!
I'm definitely finding it next time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hafuu... Still, running around so much made me tired.
I just want to take it easy for the rest of the day~.
